rationale: This is a mechanical crossover of two archive signals — it takes the exact three-channel discriminator of AddBackSolvencyRefinancingAndSelfFunding and simply swaps the loss-persistence weight for the hidden-capital weight already used in HiddenCapitalWeightedSolvencyRestatement — so it is a cosmetic recombination whose result is almost certainly interpolated between the two parents rather than a new mechanism.

Replacing the third liability-scaled earnings channel with a genuinely differently-scaled cash-conversion ratio is a substantive rather than cosmetic change and directly answers the diagnostic that the archive's third leg may be redundant with the add-back leg, though oancf/(revt−cogs) is unstable and sign-flipping when gross profit is near zero or negative and should be winsorized or guarded.

The expression is just IntangibleFirmDeteriorationSyndrome with one of its three deterioration legs deleted (equivalently KnowledgeRichDeteriorationShort with the weight swapped back), so it is a within-archive leg-pruning variant rather than a new economic channel, and the parent already achieved a similar alpha and t-stat.

Re-normalizing the refinancing channel by cuttable discretionary spending instead of total liabilities is an economically motivated change of denominator that also imports intangible-intensity information into the discriminator, but because the bounded share is monotone in dlc and enters through SUMRANK the incremental effect over NEG(dlc/lt) may be small, and dropping the rent channel means the comparison to the parent is not clean.

Adding cash-flow-coverage volatility to the already-tested margin-stability moat is a legitimate test of whether stability operates through pricing power or debt-service capacity, but it is only a one-leg extension of an existing archive winner and cash-flow-volatility pricing is close to the published earnings/cash-flow-volatility anomaly, so the incremental discovery value is modest.

Substituting a weakest-link (MIN over commonly-scaled ranks) aggregation for the additive/substitutes structures already tested is a genuine structural hypothesis about complementarity of solvency constraints, consistently signed and correctly rank-normalized, and its result would be economically informative regardless of direction — though the MIN compresses cross-sectional spread and may be dominated by whichever channel has the noisiest rank.
